DML.SELECT: SELECT transit_log_id as "id", transit_id as "transitId", assigned_user_id as "assignedUserId", transit_state_id as "transitStateId", transit_state_option_id as "transitStateOptionId", timestamp_log as "timestampLog", log_type as "logType", message as "message", visible as "visible", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM rt.transit_logs
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.transit_logs ( transit_log_id, transit_id, assigned_user_id, transit_state_id, transit_state_option_id, timestamp_log, log_type, message, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES( :id, :transitId, :assignedUserId, :transitStateId, :transitStateOptionId, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, :logType, :message, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.transit_logs WHERE transit_log_id = :id AND transit_id = :transitId
DML.ARCHIVE: INSERT INTO hist.transit_logs ( transit_log_id, transit_id, assigned_user_id, transit_state_id, transit_state_option_id, timestamp_log, log_type, message, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES( :id, :transitId, :assignedUserId, :transitStateId, :transitStateOptionId, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, :logType, :message, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
